Rules & backup

Your calculation rules

Uses 2026 CMS work RVUs with your custom productivity adjustments.

  • Within each scope: highest selected technique at 100%, additional techniques at 50%. Snare + forceps = snare + half the forceps value.
  • Colon / EGD: calculate each side first; higher subtotal at 100%, lower subtotal at 50%.
  • Multiple techniques assume separate lesions. EMR includes biopsy/snare of its own lesion; do not select those again for that lesion.
  • Averages = total wRVUs ÷ dates with saved entries. Empty dates are never counted.

These are your tracking rules, not a Medicare billing calculator or a guarantee of employer credit. Full precision is retained; displayed totals are rounded to 2 decimals.

Keep a copy

Export a JSON backup to transfer phones. Import merges entries by ID, keeps newer edits, and honors saved deletions.

Install & updates

iPhone: open in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Once loaded, the app works offline. New versions are checked on opening and applied automatically when no entry is being edited.

Entries remain in this browser/device. Back up before clearing website data or changing phones. No patient names or identifiers are collected.

Import backup

Existing entries will be merged, not replaced. Matching IDs are kept only once; newer edits and deletions win.
